settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: We currently deliver within Europe. Final delivery availability and shipping price are confirmed at checkout based on the delivery address.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Romania orders are usually delivered within 1–3 business days after dispatch. EU delivery time depends on the destination country and selected shipping method.

settings.question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
settings.answer: Cash on delivery is available only for Romania, where supported by the courier. EU orders outside Romania are prepaid.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: After dispatch, you will receive a confirmation email with tracking details. Tracking may take several hours to update after the parcel is handed to the courier.

settings.question: Can I return my order?
settings.answer: You may request a return according to the return conditions shown on the Returns page. Returned items must be unused, complete and in their original packaging.

settings.question: Can I return a personalised item?
settings.answer: Personalised products are made to order and may have limited return eligibility, unless the item is defective, damaged or incorrectly produced.

settings.question: What if I received the wrong or damaged item?
settings.answer: Contact customer support with your order number and photos of the product and packaging. We will review the case and provide the next steps.

settings.question: What warranty applies to my product?
settings.answer: Products are covered by the applicable legal conformity guarantee under Romanian and EU consumer law. Commercial warranty conditions, where offered, are shown on the product page.

settings.question: What is not covered?
settings.answer: Normal wear, accidental damage, misuse, cosmetic changes from everyday use and damage caused by improper care are not covered as product defects.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We support major card payments and selected express payment methods such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and Revolut Pay where available. The final payment methods are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Why was my payment declined?
settings.answer: A payment may be declined by the card issuer, payment provider or fraud protection system. Please check your card details, available balance and bank authorization settings, or try another payment method.

settings.question: Can I request a company invoice?
settings.answer: Yes. Add your company details during checkout where the invoice option is available. Please check that the company name, address and VAT ID are correct before completing the order.

settings.question: How does VAT work for EU companies?
settings.answer: For EU companies with a valid VAT ID, reverse charge may apply where legally available. For Romanian companies, Romanian VAT is applied according to local rules.

settings.question: Can I personalise my product?
settings.answer: Selected products can be personalised with initials or a short name. Available personalisation options are shown on the product page.

settings.question: Can I change personalisation after placing the order?
settings.answer: Contact us as soon as possible. Once production has started, personalisation details may no longer be changed.

settings.question: How do I care for my phone or laptop case?
settings.answer: Clean the surface with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Avoid abrasive cleaners, alcohol-based products, prolonged heat exposure and sharp objects.

settings.question: How do I care for apparel?
settings.answer: Follow the care label inside the garment. Wash inside out with similar colours and avoid aggressive bleaching or high heat drying.

settings.heading: Help Center
settings.intro: Everything you need to know about delivery, returns, payment, product care and customer support.
settings.contact_text: Contact our customer support team and include your order number when relevant.
settings.bottom_note: This page provides general customer service information. Final delivery, tax and payment details are confirmed at checkout.
